supporting_evidence: {'Contact dermatitis vs Lichen simplex chronicus': ['Raised, slightly erythematous lesions with scaling and crusting suggest chronic inflammation.', 'History of itching supports chronic inflammatory condition.'], 'Contact dermatitis vs Seborrheic keratosis': ['Well-circumscribed, slightly raised, erythematous lesions with scaling and crusting are more characteristic of seborrheic keratosis.'], 'Contact dermatitis vs Pityriasis rosea': ['Lesions are not annular and do not have the typical herald patch seen in pityriasis rosea.'], 'Lichen simplex chronicus vs Seborrheic keratosis': ['Lesions are not waxy or keratotic, which is more typical for seborrheic keratosis.'], 'Lichen simplex chronicus vs Pityriasis rosea': ['Lesions are not annular and do not have the typical herald patch seen in pityriasis rosea.'], 'Seborrheic keratosis vs Pityriasis rosea': ['Lesions are not annular and do not have the typical herald patch seen in pityriasis rosea.']}
conflicting_evidence: {'Contact dermatitis vs Lichen simplex chronicus': ['The presence of scaling and crusting could be seen in both conditions.'], 'Contact dermatitis vs Seborrheic keratosis': ['The morphology of the lesions does not fully align with the typical presentation of seborrheic keratosis.'], 'Contact dermatitis vs Pityriasis rosea': ['The lack of annular configuration and herald patch rules out pityriasis rosea.'], 'Lichen simplex chronicus vs Seborrheic keratosis': ['The morphology of the lesions does not fully align with the typical presentation of seborrheic keratosis.'], 'Lichen simplex chronicus vs Pityriasis rosea': ['The lack of annular configuration and herald patch rules out pityriasis rosea.'], 'Seborrheic keratosis vs Pityriasis rosea': ['The lack of annular configuration and herald patch rules out pityriasis rosea.']}

required_missing_evidence: Clinical examination of the lesions for a warty appearance, surface texture, and border definition would strengthen the exclusion of seborrheic keratosis.
